title: New Matrix can be cancelled and creates nothing
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin whose role has 'Settings — Parts' and 'See Financial Data'.
  • Note the number of matrices the Matrices tab shows (for example 7).
  • Use a desktop browser window at least 1440 pixels wide, at 100% zoom, so every column of the page shows.
custom_steps:
1. Click the Matrices tab on Settings › Pricing.
  2. Click New Matrix.
  3. Type a name no other matrix uses.
  4. Click Cancel.
  5. Click Discard Changes.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • The list shows the noted number of matrices.

Step 2:

  • A New Matrix page opens with an empty name field.

Step 3:

  • The name shows in the field.

Step 4:

  • A question asks whether to discard the changes.

Step 5:

  • The Matrices list shows again.
  • The count is the noted number (7 = 7): nothing was created.
